title: Welcome
body: We made this site so visitors to Korea can travel a little more easily and usefully. It's free to use—feedback for improvements is always welcome. Whether you're planning a trip or already here, we hope you have a wonderful time.
bodyShare: Food and tips on this site will not be based only on random web info—we'll prioritize places that people who actually visited said were good. If you have great experiences or restaurant recommendations from your Korea trip, please check the inquiry/feedback section at the bottom of the main page. You can share tips or find contact details there, and we'll review them for the guide.
